purpose: Prioritize a 60-90 second eyes-free morning briefing for Jordan Chen using consequence, preparation value, user preferences, privacy, and deduplication.

P0.name: must_speak
P0.definition: Missing the item could cause missed prep, missed deadline, conflict, owner risk, compliance/legal/security exposure, executive visibility risk, or blocked teams.
P0.audio_rule: Include in briefing unless privacy masking prevents meaningful mention; if omitted, explain in metadata.

examples.reason: Jordan owns the 9:00 roadmap agenda and needs a recommendation for Priya on pulling GA forward at 10:30.
CEO asks Jordan to review board deck slides 8-14 before the 2:00 board prep; ARR projection is the critical detail.
Same-day legal/compliance sync with final PSD3 text affecting SCA exemptions and fraud-data sharing.
Action-required partner credential rotation by 2026-05-20; Jordan is listed owner and unrotated keys will be revoked.
Maya is an always-include tracked entity, and her 1:00 call overlaps the 1:15 ACME Bank customer interview.
Cobalt Labs payments GA is public, directly tied to Jordan's product area, and mentions Stripe as a partner.

P1.name: speak_if_room
P1.definition: Meaningfully improves partner/customer/competitive decision quality, but is lower urgency than P0.
P1.audio_rule: Include only after P0 compression fits within 90 seconds.

examples.reason: Stripe lunch includes a new partner lead and likely Issuing discussion; news gives market context.
Tracked competitor has funding and leadership news ahead of the 4:00 competitive teardown.
Core integration vendor faces legal/reputational risk; separate from credential rotation.
Top-20 enterprise customer escalation needs product input by Monday.
Product-owner review requested for a payments rounding bug.

P2.name: metadata_first
P2.definition: Relevant to stated interests, but no clear same-day action or high consequence.
P2.audio_rule: Usually omit from audio on a busy day; record in metadata as considered or dropped.

examples.reason: Crypto enforcement is allowed by profile exception, unlike crypto price moves.
Applied AI and developer-tool news matches interests but does not affect today's schedule.
Fintech/regulatory context is relevant but weaker than PSD3 and Plaid actions.
Potentially useful cost/platform context, but no direct same-day owner action.

P3.name: drop_by_default
P3.definition: Low consequence, off-preference, automated, promotional, duplicated, or private detail.
P3.audio_rule: Do not include in audio unless promoted by a stronger rule.

examples.reason: Routine standup and focus block have no special consequence unless used for sequencing.
Digest, recruiter, social, promotional, or mass-thread noise.
Sports, entertainment, or crypto price movement conflicts with profile preferences.
Not enough user-specific consequence for a busy 75-second morning briefing.

thresholds.P3: score <= 1 or any hard drop rule

dropped_topic_rules.description: Drop sports scores, standings, and game recaps.
Drop cryptocurrency price movement unless paired with regulation or enforcement.
Drop automated, promotional, recruiter, mass, social, and digest emails unless they provide evidence for a P0/P1 bundle.
Drop general news without a user-specific consequence when P0/P1 items fill the time budget.

privacy_rules.metadata_guidance: Use IDs and high-level privacy transformation notes instead of copying sensitive summaries verbatim.

deduplication_bundle_rules.merge_reason: Same PSD3 final-text event and same-day compliance meeting.
deduplication_bundle_rules.spoken_once_as: Read Rahul's PSD3 notes before the 3:00 compliance sync; final text changes strong customer authentication exemptions and fraud-data sharing.

deduplication_bundle_rules.merge_reason: Lunch context and Stripe Issuing expansion are partner-relevant and should not be repeated as separate news.
deduplication_bundle_rules.spoken_once_as: For lunch with Stripe, expect Jess Park and an Issuing conversation; Stripe just expanded Issuing to five more markets.

deduplication_bundle_rules.merge_reason: Multiple Lyra items support the same competitive-teardown context.
deduplication_bundle_rules.spoken_once_as: For the Lyra teardown, note the new funding and new president as signs of enterprise-sales pressure.

deduplication_bundle_rules.merge_reason: Email supplies the prep action for the scheduled CEO board-prep meeting.
deduplication_bundle_rules.spoken_once_as: Before the 2:00 CEO board prep, review slides eight through fourteen, especially ARR.

deduplication_bundle_rules.merge_reason: Calendar and email describe the same Maya call, and it conflicts with the customer interview.
deduplication_bundle_rules.spoken_once_as: Resolve the one o'clock Maya call because it overlaps the one fifteen ACME Bank interview.

deduplication_bundle_rules.merge_reason: Single public launch story; do not repeat lower-signal Cobalt mentions unless tied to a stronger action.
deduplication_bundle_rules.spoken_once_as: Cobalt payments is publicly out of beta with four billion in beta volume and Stripe named as a partner.

deduplication_bundle_rules.merge_reason: Same tracked vendor but not the same event; keep separate in metadata. In audio, lead with credential rotation and only append lawsuit context if time remains.
deduplication_bundle_rules.spoken_once_as: Plaid credential rotation is the action; lawsuit context is optional if there is room.

final_selection_order: Include all P0 bundles, compressed to one sentence each.
If over 90 seconds, preserve P0 action verbs and drop P1/P2 entirely before dropping P0 detail.
Add P1 bundles in this order if room: Stripe lunch, Lyra teardown, Vertex escalation, Plaid lawsuit, rounding PR.
Use P2 only on unusually light days or in metadata.
Record every omitted P1/P2/P3 item in dropped_items with the rule or time-budget reason.
